_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: Catastrophic theme score collapse in run 2026-07-26T19:16:45: Monday mean_theme_score 26.6→7.1, Tuesday 26.6→3.0, Wednesday 26.6→8.4, Thursday 26.6→4.2 (all from stable ~26.6 baseline across prior 14 runs). Composite score histograms show near-total concentration in 0-19 band: Monday 237/250 articles, Tuesday 249/250, Thursday 250/250. Friday/Saturday/Sunday recovered to 35-45 range in the same run, ruling out global scoring failure. This is either a scoring_prompt regression or a sudden upstream content shift specific to weekday themes. Theme-specific keyword lists have not changed recently. The collapse is severe and immediate (not gradual drift), indicating a prompt-level bug or a fundamental mismatch between theme definitions and available content.

actions_taken.action: None—this requires human review of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a scoring failure. Flagging as open recurring issue pending human intervention.
